title: French billionaire Bolloré to face corruption trial linked to African elections
summary: French ⁠billionaire Vincent Bolloré will stand trial on charges of embezzlement and corruption related to election campaigns in two African countries. Bolloré is ⁠suspected of having bribed foreign officials ‌during the election campaign of presidents Faure Gnassingbe ⁠in Togo and Alpha Conde in Guinea, prosecutors said.
